description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called FitnessCarousel, which displays a horizontally scrollable list of workout cards. Each card shows details about a workout and handles tap events to trigger a callback.

classes.name: FitnessCarousel
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a horizontal list of workout cards with scrolling and tap functionality.

methods.name: FitnessCarousel
methods.description: Constructor for the widget, requiring a list of workouts and a callback for when a workout is tapped.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the carousel, creating a horizontally scrollable list of focusable workout cards.
